lastCompletedStory.title: Add count-agnostic real-file smoke test for the patterns.md parser

nextStoryContext: US-001 was the only story in this PRD; all stories now have passes:true. Exported parsePatternsBullets/isResolved (pure `export` addition, no behavioral change) from src/commands/patterns-archive.ts so test/commands/patterns-archive.test.ts could add a real-file smoke test that loads the actual scripts/cam/patterns.md and cross-checks the parser's resolved-bullet segmentation (blocks.filter(isResolved).length) against an independent raw-text regex scan (/\[resolved \d{4}-\d{2}\]/g over the whole file text), not a hardcoded count. Both sides currently equal 0 (patterns.md has no strict [resolved YYYY-MM] markers right now, just one prose mention of the format), and the assertion is count-agnostic so it stays correct as markers are added/archived later.
